title: Lifecycle inspection names a missing base key or database instead of a raw ENOENT
goal: A fresh data home gets a clear message
acceptance: A committed test fails first: missing base-key or nerv.sqlite is named with how to create it; nothing changes
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18: one check and a test. Not a measurement.
